signature_data_check.name: signature_data_check
signature_data_check.detail:
length(signature_data) between 100 and 400000
    and signature_data like 'data:image/png;base64,%'

basic_medical_condition_log_catalog_snap.name: basic_medical_condition_log_catalog_snapshot_valid
basic_medical_condition_log_catalog_snap.detail:
(
      catalog_item_id_snapshot is null
      and item_name_snapshot is null
      and commercial_name_snapshot is null
      and unit_snapshot is null
    )
    or (
      catalog_item_id_snapshot is not null
      and item_name_snapshot is not null
      and btrim(item_name_snapshot) <> ''
      and unit_snapshot is not null
      and btrim(unit_snapshot) <> ''
    )

import_batches_counts_non_negative.name: import_batches_counts_non_negative
import_batches_counts_non_negative.detail:
total_rows >= 0 and valid_rows >= 0 and warning_rows >= 0 and
    error_rows >= 0 and imported_rows >= 0 and duplicate_rows >= 0 and conflict_rows >= 0

class_schedules_semester_check.name: class_schedules_semester_check
class_schedules_semester_check.detail: semester is null or semester in ('HK1', 'HK2', 'HK3', 'HK4')

class_schedules_publish_metadata.name: class_schedules_publish_metadata
class_schedules_publish_metadata.detail: (schedule_status <> 'published') or (published_at is not null and published_by is not null)

class_schedules_cancel_metadata.name: class_schedules_cancel_metadata
class_schedules_cancel_metadata.detail: (schedule_status <> 'cancelled') or (cancelled_at is not null and cancelled_by is not null)

class_schedules_lecturers_distinct.name: class_schedules_lecturers_distinct
class_schedules_lecturers_distinct.detail: lecturer_id is null or lecturer_2_id is null or lecturer_id <> lecturer_2_id

class_schedules_operating_hours.name: class_schedules_operating_hours
class_schedules_operating_hours.detail:
(
      basic_medical_registration_id is not null
      and start_time >= time '07:00'
      and end_time <= time '21:00'
    )
    or
    (
      basic_medical_registration_id is null
      and (
        (start_time >= time '07:30' and end_time <= time '11:30')
        or (start_time >= time '12:30' and end_time <= time '16:30')
      )
    )

staff_shifts_morning_time_check.name: staff_shifts_morning_time_check
staff_shifts_morning_time_check.detail:
shift_slot <> 'MORNING' or (
      start_time >= '07:00'::time
      and start_time < end_time
      and end_time <= '11:30'::time
      and extract(minute from start_time)::integer in (0, 30)
      and extract(second from start_time)::integer = 0
      and extract(minute from end_time)::integer in (0, 30)
      and extract(second from end_time)::integer = 0
    )

staff_shifts_afternoon_time_check.name: staff_shifts_afternoon_time_check
staff_shifts_afternoon_time_check.detail:
shift_slot <> 'AFTERNOON' or (
      start_time >= '12:30'::time
      and start_time < end_time
      and end_time <= '16:30'::time
      and extract(minute from start_time)::integer in (0, 30)
      and extract(second from start_time)::integer = 0
      and extract(minute from end_time)::integer in (0, 30)
      and extract(second from end_time)::integer = 0
    )

staff_shifts_cancel_metadata.name: staff_shifts_cancel_metadata
staff_shifts_cancel_metadata.detail: (status <> 'cancelled') or (cancelled_at is not null and cancelled_by is not null)

equipment_requests_late_approval_reason_.name: equipment_requests_late_approval_reason_required
equipment_requests_late_approval_reason_.detail:
late_approval_status = 'not_required'
    or nullif(btrim(late_registration_reason), '') is not null

equipment_requests_late_review_valid.name: equipment_requests_late_review_valid
equipment_requests_late_review_valid.detail:
(late_approval_status in ('not_required','pending') and late_reviewed_by is null and late_reviewed_at is null)
    or (late_approval_status in ('approved','rejected') and late_reviewed_by is not null and late_reviewed_at is not null)

equipment_requests_handover_signature_va.name: equipment_requests_handover_signature_valid
equipment_requests_handover_signature_va.detail:
handover_recipient_signature is null or (
      length(handover_recipient_signature) between 100 and 400000
      and handover_recipient_signature like 'data:image/png;base64,%'
    )

equipment_requests_return_signature_vali.name: equipment_requests_return_signature_valid
equipment_requests_return_signature_vali.detail:
return_recipient_signature is null or (
      length(return_recipient_signature) between 100 and 400000
      and return_recipient_signature like 'data:image/png;base64,%'
    )

equipment_requests_live_link_domain_chec.name: equipment_requests_live_link_domain_check
equipment_requests_live_link_domain_chec.detail: class_schedule_id is not null or request_domain = 'basic_medical'
